title: Grateful Dead Live at Campolindo High School on 1969-05-16
lineage: SBD > MC > C > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Rough high‑school audience recording of a lackluster late‑60s show, with only occasional bright spots like School Girl and Love Light.
ai_review.review: The tape captures an uninspired early Dead set recorded in a high‑school gym, so the sound is lo‑fi but surprisingly clear for an audience cassette. Musically the band sounds weary – Hard to Handle is especially flat – though a few moments (School Girl, Love Light) still shine and Pigpen’s soulful presence is noted. Overall it’s more of a historical curiosity than a compelling listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show poorly (1‑2 stars) citing weak performance and low energy; recording is judged only modestly decent for an audience source, leading to a low combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded on a high‑school auditorium cassette; surprisingly clear given the venue but still lo‑fi, muffled in places and lacking the polish of soundboard tapes.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Uninspired setlist with little momentum; the band sounds sluggish and disengaged for most of the evening.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Reviewers note Jerry (and Phil) sounding serious but essentially phoning it in, giving an overall tentative feel to his playing.
band_member_comments.Phil: Comments mention Phil talking about the music seriously; no specific praise for bass work.
